store.description:
Screenlight Mobile turns the screen of your iPhone, iPad or Mac into a soft, even light – in exactly the color and brightness you need.

The LED on the back of a phone is harsh and has only one setting. Your screen is gentle on the eyes, can be dimmed and can shine in any color. Open the app and the light is on.

MADE FOR ONE HAND
• Big on/off button and wide brightness slider at the bottom of the screen
• Swipe up or down on the light to change the brightness, sideways to change the color
• Tap the light to hide the controls – then the whole screen shines

ANY COLOR, ANY WHITE
• Ten ready-made colors
• White tone from warm candlelight to cool daylight
• Pick any color you like and save your favorites

MODES
• Steady light
• SOS distress signal in Morse code
• Candle with a soft flicker
• Disco, Rainbow and Fade between two colors of your choice

USEFUL DETAILS
• Auto-off timer from 1 to 60 minutes – ideal as a night light
• The screen stays awake while the light is on
• On iPhone and iPad the screen switches to full brightness and returns to your setting afterwards
• Animations pause when the light is off, to save battery
• Works with VoiceOver, large text and Reduce Motion
• On the Mac: keyboard shortcuts and full screen

GOOD FOR
• Reading in bed without waking anyone
• A night light for children
• Soft fill light for photos, selfies and video calls
• Red light that preserves your night vision when stargazing
• Finding the keyhole, the tent zipper or the fuse box

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Screenlight Mobile collects no data and works completely offline.
